tag_line: Tag the colleague who checks your work twice.

rank.line: Reads your slides. Fixes the font. Then the spacing.
rank.plus: Nothing leaves the team with a typo.

rank.line: Asks for a status update on the status update.
Has a process for the process. Laminated.
"Just checking in!" Four times before lunch.
Notices you changed one word in the email.
rank.plus: Spots the problem before the client does.

caption:
Which element is the micro-manager? 👀

In Chinese astrology your element comes from the day you were born. Metal loves standards, Earth loves systems, Yin Fire notices everything. Great qualities, until they are checking your slides at 11pm.
